name: Data Browser Weighbridge (Web)

endpoints.description: List/filter data record Weighbridge (gabungan sync mobile & input web) dengan pagination
Ekspor data Weighbridge terfilter ke CSV/Excel

success_schema.note: Response body adalah file stream/binary, bukan JSON

error_codes.condition: dataset terlalu besar atau error saat proses ekspor

business_logic: 1. Validate query params (date_from/date_to) → if date_from > date_to: return 422 INVALID_DATE_RANGE, filter tidak diterapkan
2. Build query: weighbridge-record WHERE business_unit_id matches (if provided) AND record_datetime BETWEEN date_from/date_to (if provided) AND weighbridge_type matches (if provided)
5. On export: re-run query filter yang sama (termasuk weighbridge_type) tanpa pagination, generate file CSV/Excel → if dataset terlalu besar/error: return 422 EXPORT_FAILED
6. Return file stream untuk didownload user

data_operations.description: SELECT records dengan filter tanggal/tipe/business_unit, dipaginasi
SELECT records dengan filter yang sama, unpaginated, untuk keperluan ekspor

edge_case_handling.handling: Return 200 dengan data: [], FE tampilkan empty state dengan opsi reset filter
Navigasi client-side ke Detail Weighbridge (Web), bukan panggilan API tambahan

business_rules_applied: Data mencakup hasil sync mobile & input web
Daftar termuat <=2 detik untuk dataset normal
Kolom Tanggal & Waktu adalah 1 kolom tunggal (record_datetime)
Kolom Tujuan Muatan hanya terisi untuk baris bertipe Dispatch

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 INVALID_DATE_RANGE when date_from > date_to on list endpoint
unit_test_cases.expect: return 422 INVALID_DATE_RANGE, filter is not applied to the query

unit_test_cases.description: returns empty list when no records match the given filter
unit_test_cases.given: weighbridgeRecordRepo.findByFilters() returns an empty array for the given filter combination
unit_test_cases.expect: return 200 with data: [] and pagination meta { page, per_page, total: 0, total_pages: 0 }

unit_test_cases.description: returns success result when all conditions pass (list)
unit_test_cases.given: valid date_from/date_to, weighbridge_type, business_unit_id, page, per_page; weighbridgeRecordRepo.findByFilters() returns matching records within page bounds
unit_test_cases.expect: return 200 with data array of weighbridge records (including weighbridge_type, record_datetime, destination) and pagination meta (page, per_page, total, total_pages)

unit_test_cases.given: query param weighbridge_type=dispatch; weighbridgeRecordRepo.findByFilters() called with type filter
unit_test_cases.expect: return 200 with data containing only records where weighbridge_type=dispatch

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 INVALID_DATE_RANGE when date_from > date_to on export endpoint
unit_test_cases.given: query params date_from > date_to passed to the export request
unit_test_cases.expect: return 422 INVALID_DATE_RANGE, export is not performed

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 EXPORT_FAILED when dataset is too large or file generation errors
unit_test_cases.given: weighbridgeRecordRepo.findByFiltersUnpaginated() returns a dataset exceeding the export limit, or the file generator throws an error

unit_test_cases.description: returns success result when all conditions pass (export)
unit_test_cases.given: valid filter params (including weighbridge_type) and format=csv|excel; weighbridgeRecordRepo.findByFiltersUnpaginated() returns matching records within export limit; file generator succeeds
unit_test_cases.expect: return 200 with a file stream response, content-type matching the requested format (text/csv or application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

screen_dependencies.reason: Aksi Tambah Data membuka form input web

implementation_notes: Ekspor sebaiknya dijalankan sebagai proses async/background job untuk dataset besar; NFR <=2 detik hanya berlaku untuk list, tidak eksplisit untuk export
Data source gabungan: record hasil sync manual dari mobile + record input langsung dari web (screen-022)
arrival_datetime/dispatch_datetime lama disatukan menjadi record_datetime pada entity-catalog v5 — kolom tabel dan filter tanggal kini mengacu ke field tunggal ini
Kolom baru: Tipe (weighbridge_type) dan Tujuan Muatan (destination, kosong/'-' untuk baris Receive)

component_test.action: set filter inputs (date_from, date_to, business unit dropdown) and apply; click export button with format selection
component_test.assert: table rows render matching the filtered records, including Tipe and Tujuan Muatan columns; export triggers a file-download response with correct filename/content-type

browser_test.action: navigate to the page, fill date range filter and select business unit, click Apply, then click Export and choose CSV/Excel
browser_test.assert: table updates to show only the filtered records; browser triggers a file download for the exported file

test_scenarios.scenario_ref: Telusuri & Ekspor Data Weighbridge — Filter Berdasarkan Tipe

component_test.action: select Tipe filter = Dispatch (or Receive) and apply
component_test.assert: table rows render only records matching the selected weighbridge_type

browser_test.action: select the Tipe filter dropdown, choose Dispatch, apply
browser_test.assert: table updates to show only Dispatch records

test_scenarios.scenario_ref: Telusuri & Ekspor Data Weighbridge — Tidak Ada Data Sesuai Filter

component_test.action: apply a filter combination that yields no matching records
component_test.assert: empty state message is displayed together with a reset-filter option

browser_test.action: apply a filter combination that produces zero results
browser_test.assert: page shows a 'no data found' message with a reset filter button

test_scenarios.scenario_ref: Telusuri & Ekspor Data Weighbridge — Rentang Tanggal Tidak Valid

component_test.action: set date_from later than date_to and submit the filter
component_test.assert: validation error message is shown, filter is not applied, table remains unchanged

browser_test.action: enter a start date later than the end date in the filter and apply
browser_test.assert: browser displays a validation error message, results are not filtered

test_scenarios.scenario_ref: Telusuri & Ekspor Data Weighbridge — Klik Baris Membuka Detail

component_test.action: click on a row in the data table
component_test.assert: component dispatches a navigation event to the Detail Weighbridge route for the selected record id; no additional API call is triggered

browser_test.action: click on a table row for a specific weighbridge record
browser_test.assert: browser navigates to the Detail Weighbridge page (/data/weighbridge/{id}) for the selected record

test_scenarios.scenario_ref: Telusuri & Ekspor Data Weighbridge — Ekspor Gagal

component_test.action: click export with a filter that produces an oversized dataset or triggers an export processing error
component_test.assert: error message indicating export failure is displayed; no file is downloaded

browser_test.action: click Export with a filter that yields an oversized dataset or causes an export processing error
browser_test.assert: browser shows an export-failure error message; no file download is initiated
